notes: Docs raw path params: device_id, command_id

title: Get Commands
notes: Docs OpenAPI requestBody repeats device_id, but the verified route uses device_id as a path parameter and this GET request must not send a body.
Returns command queue/history entries that can be matched by command id; it does not describe model-supported commands.
The verified response uses items plus has_next_page, and per_page accepts at most 500 entries.

title: Send Command
notes: Docs 422 example explicitly requires a valid command or friendly_name, which implies a request payload even when requestBody schema is absent in SSR data.
The request selector is command or friendly_name; name is the model metadata field, not a send request field.
Send request parameters belong in a JSON object under extra_params; params is returned in command responses and history.

For custom fields with embedded model-provided options and unambiguous single- or multi-value cardinality, send the exact model-defined scalar value or array of values; option support is not limited to fields whose general type is select or multiselect.
The documented send response is an array; command polling accepts a command object or an exactly one-item array only when it contains one unambiguous command id.

title: Claim Device
notes: Response includes effective_status (nullable string): one of ok, warning, error, offline, disconnected, never_seen. Computed device status reflecting incident priority, connectivity, telemetry-seen state, and raw device status.

title: Merge Device

title: Split Device
notes: Detaches a shadow device from its primary.

title: Update Device
notes: Edge devices support custom_parameters in this update endpoint. custom_parameters is a complete replacement write: send every parameter value you want to keep, not only changed values.
Validate custom_parameters keys against organization.models.getModel parameters[].name before writing. Masked password sentinels such as ***** must not be re-sent as real values.
Live local route check confirms /core/v1/organization/devices/:device_id is callable; /core/v1/organization/:device_id returns 404.

title: Get Devices
notes: Paginated response includes items plus a continuation field. Shared docs describe has_next_page; live Verve/Playground responses on 2026-07-06 returned next_page. Handle either field. page starts at 1; per_page defaults to 100 and is capped at 100.

Response includes effective_status (nullable string): one of ok, warning, error, offline, disconnected, never_seen. Computed device status reflecting incident priority, connectivity, telemetry-seen state, and raw device status.

title: Start Edge Claim
notes: Async endpoint: returns 204; poll organization.edge.getClaimStatus until pending/success/failed.
Optional mac accepts common MAC formats and is normalized by the server; invalid mac returns 422. Optional sn assigns a serial number at claim time.
Use organization.models.getModels with edge_only=true and organization.models.getModel to discover model ids and supported custom_parameters keys before claims.
Catalog uses the documented plural /core/v1/organization/edges/devices/start_claim route.

title: Update Edge Device Hostname
notes: Updates the IP/hostname an edge device is reachable on; syncs the address to the Edge monitoring configuration and preserves the device's custom parameter values.
Unless skip_connectivity_check is true, a successful connectivity check for the new address must be performed first (organization.edge.startPing / organization.edge.getPingStatus).
Customer docs PR xyte-io/customer-docs-portal#20 documents this endpoint; server PR xyte-io/server#8943 adds it.

title: Get Model
notes: Returns one accessible, published device model including parameters and commands.
Use parameters[].name as the accepted key set for Edge custom_parameters. Parameter types include text, textarea, password, number, and file.
Model commands returned here describe model-supported commands; device-specific command history and queue state remain under organization.commands.getCommands.

title: Get Models
notes: Paginated list of accessible, published device models. page defaults to 1; per_page defaults to 100 and is capped at 100.
Response shape is { items: Model[], next_page: number | null }.
Use edge_only=true for Edge model discovery before edge claims and already-claimed Edge custom-parameter updates.
Response items include parameters[].name, parameters[].type, and parameters[].required for custom parameter planning.
